form_name: Form 14 — LIC Policy Payment from PF
description: Request form used to pay LIC (Life Insurance Corporation) policy premiums directly from your Provident Fund balance.

fields.name: Name of Member (Employee)
fields.description: Your full name as per EPFO records.

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Father's name for unmarried; spouse's name for married employees.

fields.name: PF Account Number
fields.description: Your current EPF account number with EPFO.

fields.name: Name of Establishment
fields.description: Full name of your current employer.

fields.name: Policy Number (LIC)
fields.description: The LIC policy number for which you want premiums paid from PF.

fields.name: Date of Premium Due
fields.description: The due date of the premium in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Amount Available in PF
fields.description: This is calculated automatically — you must have adequate PF balance.

fields.name: Employee Signature with Date
fields.description: Your signature authorizing deduction from PF for LIC premium payment.

fields.name: Employer Certification
fields.description: Employer certifies the employment details and forwards to the EPFO office.
